An item used in place of another item.

replacement.englishDescription: An act of taking the place of a predecessor and performing his/her role; or such a person or task.

rotation.definitionKo: 지구가 태양의 둘레를 돌거나 달이 지구의 둘레를 도는 것처럼, 한 천체가 다른 천체의 둘레를 일정하게 도는 것.
rotation.englishDescription: One heavenly body rotating around another, such as the earth rotating around the sun or the moon rotating around the earth.

rotation.definitionKo: 어떤 일을 여러 사람이 나누어서 차례를 바꾸어 가며 함.
rotation.englishDescription: The act of assuming or taking on certain tasks in a particular order by dividing them among various persons.

rotation.definitionKo: 차례대로 돌아 전체를 돈 횟수를 세는 단위.
rotation.englishDescription: The unit for counting the number of rotated turns.

rotation.definitionKo: 어떤 행동이나 현상이 하나의 과정을 지나 다시 처음 자리로 돌아오는 것을 되풀이함.
rotation.englishDescription: The act of following a set sequence in which an action or phenomenon goes through a process and then goes back to its original position again.

rotation.definitionKo: 어떤 것을 중심으로 하여 그 주위를 빙빙 돎.

sangyeo.definitionKo: 사람의 시체를 묘지까지 실어 나르는 데 쓰는 도구.

sap.englishDescription: The sap of a tree or the juice of a fruit.

sap.definitionKo: 땅속에서 뿌리와 줄기를 통해 잎으로 전달되는, 나무의 영양분이 되는 액체.
sap.englishDescription: A liquid that serves as nutrition, delivered through the roots and stems to the leaves of a tree.

sap.definitionKo: 풀이나 나무의 껍질 등에서 나오는 끈끈한 물질.
sap.englishDescription: A sticky substance that is excreted from grass or tree bark.
Liquid produced in the body of a living thing.

scarf.definitionKo: 추위를 막기 위하여 목에 두르는 것.
scarf.englishDescription: An article of clothing worn around the neck to keep out the cold.

seomjigi.englishDescription: A bound noun that serves as a unit for measuring the width of a rice paddy or field.

shortcut.definitionKo: 목적지까지 빠르게 갈 수 있는 길.

shortcut.englishDescription: A shorter way to get to a destination.
(figurative) A method that reduces the time or energy needed to accomplish something.

shortcut.englishDescription: A route that cuts through a road or street.

skim.englishDescription: To go over or examine something in a certain range from the start to the end.

skydiving.definitionKo: 높은 고도의 하늘에서 낙하산을 펴지 않고 낙하하다가 지상 가까이에서 낙하산을 펴서 착륙하는 스포츠.
skydiving.englishDescription: A sport in which you fall from the sky at a high altitude without opening a parachute, and then land with a parachute close to the ground.

spaghetti.englishDescription: A dish made with long, thin Italian noodles.

spoil.englishDescription: To ruin something or make something into an unusable state.

spoil.definitionKo: 어떤 일이나 형편을 좋지 않게 하거나 잘못되게 하다.
spoil.englishDescription: To make a matter or situation worse or go wrong.

spoil.definitionKo: 상하게 하거나 더럽혀서 쓰지 못하게 망치다.
spoil.englishDescription: To make something unusable by damaging it or making it dirty.

stabilization.definitionKo: 변하거나 흔들리지 않고 일정한 상태를 유지해 감. 또는 그렇게 되게 함.

The act of having one's body and mind comfortable and quiet.

stabilization.englishDescription: The act of having one's body and mind comfortable and quiet in order to heal a disease.

strivingly.definitionKo: 무엇을 이루기 위해 애를 쓰거나 우겨 대는 모양.

twilight.definitionKo: 해가 지고 조금씩 어두워지는 때. 또는 그때의 빛.
twilight.englishDescription: The time of slight darkness between the sunset and night; or the light that shines during this time.

twilight.definitionKo: (비유적으로) 사람의 생애나 나라의 운명 등이 한창인 고비를 지나 점점 약해져 마지막에 이른 상태.
twilight.englishDescription: (figurative) A state in which one's life or a country's fate weakens past its peak and reaches its end.

twilight.definitionKo: (비유적으로) 사람의 생애나 나라의 운명 등이 한창인 고비를 지나 점점 약해져 마지막에 이른 때.
twilight.englishDescription: (figurative) A state in which one's life or a country's fate weakens past its peak and reaches its end.

unskilledness.definitionKo: 어떤 일에 익숙하지 못하고 서투른 성질.
unskilledness.englishDescription: A quality of being unfamiliar with and therefore not adept at something.

untitled.definitionKo: 글이나 노래, 그림 등의 제목이 없음. 또는 일정한 제목이 없다는 뜻으로 붙인 제목.
untitled.englishDescription: Absence of a title in writings, songs, paintings, etc.; or an title given to indicate that there is no fixed title.

urbanize.definitionKo: 도시의 문화가 전해져서 도시가 아닌 곳이 도시처럼 되다. 또는 그렇게 만들다.
urbanize.englishDescription: For a place that is not a city to become urban with the spread of urban culture; to make such a place become urban.

volume.englishDescription: The amount of space that something occupies.
A bound noun that serves as a unit for counting the number of books or notebooks.

volume.definitionKo: 여러 책으로 이루어진 전집 등에서, 책의 순서를 나타내는 말.
volume.englishDescription: A bound noun used to indicate the ordinal number of a volume, as in a series of books.

volume.definitionKo: 주로 옛날 책에서, 책을 내용에 따라 구분하는 단위.
volume.englishDescription: A bound noun that serves as a unit for distinguishing books based on their contents, particularly in old books.

volume.definitionKo: 일정한 공간에 들어갈 수 있는 분량.
volume.englishDescription: The amount that can fit into a certain space.

volume.definitionKo: 물건을 담을 수 있는 부피. 또는 어떤 공간을 차지하는 분량.
volume.englishDescription: The volume that can accommodate a certain object; or the amount occupying a certain space.

volume.definitionKo: 옛 서적이나 여러 장의 종이를 하나로 묶은 것을 세는 단위.
volume.englishDescription: A unit for counting the number of old books or several pages of paper bound into one.
The level of a certain sound.

waggish.definitionKo: 다른 사람을 웃기려고 일부러 재미있는 말이나 행동을 하는 태도가 있다.
waggish.englishDescription: Often making or doing a funny remark or act intended to amuse others.

waggish.definitionKo: 다른 사람을 웃기려고 일부러 재미있는 말이나 행동을 하는 데가 있다.
waggish.englishDescription: Often making or doing a funny remark or act intended to amuse others.

waveringly.definitionKo: 물체가 이리저리 가볍게 자꾸 흔들리는 모양.
waveringly.englishDescription: A word describing the motion of a small object swaying back and forth gently.

waveringly.definitionKo: 작은 물체가 이리저리 가볍게 흔들리는 모양.
waveringly.englishDescription: A word describing the movement of a small object swaying gently back and forth.

waveringly.definitionKo: 얇고 가벼운 물체가 바람에 날리어 자꾸 흔들리는 모양.
waveringly.englishDescription: A word describing the motion of a thin object swaying lightly and repeatedly in the wind.

waveringly.definitionKo: 얇은 물체가 바람에 날리어 자꾸 가볍게 움직이는 모양.
waveringly.englishDescription: A word describing the motion of a thin object swaying lightly and repeatedly in the wind.

waveringly.definitionKo: 물결이나 큰 천, 나뭇잎 등이 부드럽고 느리게 자꾸 흔들거리며 움직이는 모양.
waveringly.englishDescription: A word describing the manner of a wave, big cloth, leaf, etc., wavering gently, slowly, and repeatedly.

waveringly.definitionKo: 무늬나 그림자 등이 물결을 지어 자꾸 움직이는 모양.
waveringly.englishDescription: In a state in which a pattern, shadow, etc., moves continuously in waves.

waveringly.definitionKo: 물이나 거울 등에 비친 그림자가 자꾸 흔들리는 모양.
waveringly.englishDescription: In a state in which a shadow in the water, mirror, etc., sways continuously.

waveringly.definitionKo: 뚜렷하거나 적극적인 의지 없이 되는대로 행동하는 모양.
waveringly.englishDescription: In the manner of behaving irresponsibly without a definite or strong will.
A word describing the motion of a wave keeping rising and falling.

waveringly.definitionKo: 얇은 판 등이 휘어지듯이 계속 흔들리며 움직이는 모양.
waveringly.englishDescription: A word describing the motion of a thin board, etc., continuously swaying as if it were being bent.
A word describing the motion of swaying back and forth lightly and repeatedly.
A word describing the motion of an object swaying slightly.

waveringly.definitionKo: 가늘고 긴 것이 탄력 있게 휘어지며 느리게 한 번 흔들리는 모양.
waveringly.englishDescription: A word describing the motion of a thin, long object bending flexibly and waving slowly for one time.

waveringly.definitionKo: 가늘고 긴 것이 탄력 있게 휘어지며 자꾸 느리게 흔들리는 모양.
waveringly.englishDescription: A word describing the motion of a thin, long object bending flexibly and waving slowly, repeatedly.

waveringly.definitionKo: 마음이나 생각 등이 단단하지 못해 이리저리 자꾸 망설이는 모양.
waveringly.englishDescription: In the state of hesitating continuously because one's mind or conviction is not firm.

waveringly.definitionKo: 크고 긴 물건이나 물결 등이 자꾸 이리저리 크게 흔들리는 모양.
waveringly.englishDescription: A word describing the motion of a big, long thing, wave, etc., swaying this way and that.
A word describing the motion of a flame moving back and forth.

welder.definitionKo: 두 개의 금속, 유리, 플라스틱 등을 녹여 서로 이어 붙이는 일을 직업으로 하는 사람.
welder.englishDescription: A person whose job it is to connect two pieces of metal, glass, plastic, etc., by heating them.

whimper.englishDescription: To cry sorrowfully while gulping down one's tears.

whimper.definitionKo: 아기가 아프거나 졸리거나 마음에 차지 않아 자꾸 울거나 짜증을 내다.
whimper.englishDescription: For a baby to keep crying or throwing tantrums when it is sleepy or unhappy.

whimper.definitionKo: 어린아이가 얼굴을 찡그리며 보기에 미운 얼굴로 자꾸 울다.
whimper.englishDescription: For a child to cry with an ugly-looking, frowning face continuously.

whimper.definitionKo: 마음에 들지 않거나 못마땅하여 계속해서 자꾸 울거나 짜증을 내다.
whimper.englishDescription: To cry or throw tantrums repeatedly when dissatisfied or displeased.

whimper.definitionKo: 어린아이가 얼굴을 찡그리며 보기에 미운 얼굴로 자꾸 울다.
whimper.englishDescription: For a child to cry with an ugly-looking, frowning face continuously.

whimper.definitionKo: 어린아이가 얼굴을 찡그리며 보기에 미운 얼굴로 울다.
whimper.englishDescription: For a child to cry with an ugly-looking, frowning face.

whimper.definitionKo: 마음에 들지 않거나 못마땅하여 계속해서 자꾸 울거나 짜증을 내다.
whimper.englishDescription: To cry or throw tantrums repeatedly when dissatisfied or displeased.

whimper.definitionKo: 마음에 들지 않거나 못마땅하여 자꾸 울거나 짜증을 내다.
whimper.englishDescription: To cry or throw tantrums repeatedly when dissatisfied or displeased.

witty.definitionKo: 우습고 재미있으면서도 품위가 있는 말이나 행동이 있는.
witty.englishDescription: Being characterized by words or actions that are funny and entertaining yet refined.

witty.definitionKo: 순간순간 뛰어나거나 놀라운 생각을 잘해 내는 재치가 있다.
witty.englishDescription: Having the wit to instantly come up with brilliant or surprising ideas.

witty.definitionKo: 순간순간 갑자기 기발한 생각을 해 내는 재치가 뛰어나다.
witty.englishDescription: Being witty, as one suddenly and instantly comes up with brilliant ideas.

wolf.definitionKo: 개와 비슷하게 생겼으며, 육식성으로 무리를 지어 생활하는 짐승.
wolf.englishDescription: A carnivorous beast that looks similar to a dog, and lives as a pack.
(figurative) A man who likes to seduce women.

wolf.definitionKo: 개와 비슷하게 생겼으며, 육식성으로 무리를 지어 생활하는 짐승.
wolf.englishDescription: A carnivorous beast that looks similar to a dog, and lives in a pack.

wool.englishDescription: A material for cloth, which comes from shearing the hide of a sheep.

wool.definitionKo: 따뜻하여 겨울옷에 많이 사용되는, 양의 털.
wool.englishDescription: The hair of the sheep, often used as a material for winter clothes because it retains warmth.

wool.definitionKo: 동물의 몸에서 깎아낸 털로 만든 실.
wool.englishDescription: A thread made from hair cut from the body of an animal.

wool.definitionKo: 따뜻하여 겨울옷에 많이 사용되는, 양의 털.
wool.englishDescription: The hair of the sheep, often used as a material for winter clothes because it retains warmth.

worn.englishDescription: An object being old and shabby.

yawn.definitionKo: 졸리거나 피곤하거나 배부르거나 할 때, 저절로 입이 크게 벌어지면서 하는 깊은 호흡.
yawn.englishDescription: The act of opening one's mouth wide involuntarily, followed by deep breathing when one is sleepy, tired, or full.

yawn.definitionKo: 졸리거나 피곤하거나 배부르거나 할 때, 저절로 입이 크게 벌어지면서 깊은 호흡을 하다.
yawn.englishDescription: To open one's mouth wide involuntarily, followed by deep breathing when one is sleepy, tired, or full.

yomanjoman.definitionKo: 상태나 성질 등이 짐작하거나 다스릴 수 있을 정도로.
yomanjoman.englishDescription: In a manner of the state, quality, etc., of something being easy to guess or control.

yoraeseo.englishDescription: An abbreviated word for '요리하여서' (a conjugated form of '요리하다' (do this way)).
An abbreviated word for '요러하여서' (a conjugated form of '요러하다' (be this way)).
